title: den-wiki wiki/ page frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of a page under wiki/: one page per concept, entity, comparison, synthesis or hub. Unknown keys are allowed so tools such as OpenKnowledge can add their own; lint flags relabelling keys separately.

type.description: Page type. Must be one of the types listed in taxonomy.yml (seed: concept, entity, comparison, synthesis, hub).

aliases.description: Alternative names. Search resolves aliases so a new name lands on the existing page.

sources.description: Content-root-relative paths of sources/ files this page draws on.

trails.description: Slugs of the trails (trails/<slug>.md) that changed this page.

contradicts.description: Content-root-relative paths of wiki/ pages with conflicting claims.

volatility.description: Drives staleness scoring. Missing means warm.

verified.description: Date of the last human confirmation. Only a human sets this.
